description: 熱海市伊豆山土砂災害オルソ画像 [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by NPO法人クライシスマッパーズ・ジャパン. izusanorthoimage 2021年7月3日に熱海市伊豆山で発災した土砂災害被災地のオルソ画像。 静岡県撮影のドローン空撮動画より Agisoft Metashape を用いてオルソモザイク生成を行いました。 処理は静岡点群サポートチームによるものを NPO法人CrisisMappers Japan が代理公開いたします。 --... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher NPO法人クライシスマッパーズ・ジャパン. Its tags are 2021年7月熱海市土石流災害, 静岡県, 静岡県点群サポートチーム. It offers 3 resource(s) in geotiff, tiff, xyz. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
